question.problem: Given that the random variable $X\sim \textrm{Exp}\left(\dfrac 23\right),$ calculate $P\left(X \geq 3\right).$ Round your final answer to four decimal places.
question.worked_solution:
An exponential random variable $X$ with rate $\lambda$ has the following probability density function:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14128540/assets/49fa146efc8029727469bc5909c2a946c9cb96383976d4096d455b423a428479.svg)

We're given that

$$
X\sim \textrm{Exp} \left( \dfrac 23 \right).
$$

So, $X$ has the following probability density function:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14128540/assets/721ca1810b816431f99bb8294f4ad12ff125342640a925035487c8ecace4eff6.svg)Therefore, we can calculate $P\left(X \geq 3\right)$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\ge 3) & ={\int }_{3}^{\infty }f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{3}^{\infty }\frac{2}{3}{e}^{-2x/3}\,\text{d}x \\  & =-{{e}^{-2x/3}|}_{3}^{\infty } \\  & ={e}^{-2} \\  & ≈0.1353\end{aligned}
$$
